rows.note: Use 警署 as the standard all-purpose term for a police station.

example.english: We went to Wan Chai police station to report a crime.
example.traditional: 我哋去咗灣仔警署報案。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 waan1 zai2 ging2 cyu5 bou3 on3

rows.note: Use 差館 in distinctly colloquial Cantonese, especially in familiar everyday speech.

example.english: Ming was taken to the police station for questioning.
example.traditional: 阿明畀人拉咗去差館問話。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2 heoi3 caai1 gun2 man6 waa6
